post.description: Client sends clientId and clientSecret to obtain an access token (JWT) for subsequent requests.
Get customer data by CIF Number. Requires valid access token and HMAC-SHA512 signature.

parameters.name: X-Client-ID
parameters.description: Registered Client ID

parameters.name: X-TIMESTAMP
parameters.description: ISO-8601 with an offset, for example 2026-11-10T10:00:00+07:00. Refused when more than 5 minutes old or more than 30 seconds ahead

parameters.name: X-Signature
parameters.description: Base64 HMAC-SHA512 with the client secret over METHOD:PATH:ACCESS_TOKEN:lowercase hex SHA-256 of the minified body:X-TIMESTAMP

diperbarui_pada.description: When the CBS last changed this customer: the latest of creation, edit and approval, in CBS server time (WIB), without an offset. Keep it and refresh the customer's data when a newer one arrives

menunggu_otorisasi.description: True while a CBS edit to this customer awaits a supervisor's approval. The CBS edits in place, so the data shown already includes that edit

post.description: Get the savings, loan and deposit product codes with their names. Each approved product appears once; aktif is false for a product no longer sold, so existing accounts can still be labelled. Send an empty JSON object as the body and sign it like any other body. Requires valid access token and HMAC-SHA512 signature.

AccountDetailRequest.description: The account must belong to the given CIF, otherwise the response is 404

AccountMutationsRequest.description: The account must belong to the given CIF, otherwise the response is 404. Both dates are included, start_date must not be after end_date, and the range is at most 31 days

start_date.description: First day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, included

end_date.description: Last day of the range, YYYY-MM-DD, included

aktif.description: False when the CBS no longer sells the product. Accounts on it still exist and still use this name

waktu.description: HH:MM:SS, empty string when the CBS has no time

keterangan.description: Account numbers inside are masked to the last four digits
